watch.summary: The streamer reflects on human psychology and how gamers falsely assume a video game is dead just because they and their friends stopped playing it.

beats.what: Streamer begins talking about human tendencies and self-centered bias.
Explains how when he stops caring about a game, he feels like the whole world stopped.
Gives the example of thinking nobody plays Valorant anymore.
Points out how friend groups assume their own burnout means a game is dead.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: When I stop caring about something, the whole world stops caring about it.
watch.why: This is a serious real-talk commentary segment about gamer psychology rather than comedic material. It relies on relatable observational discussion instead of humorous setups or punchlines.
